system.description:
This incantation may be used to move earth or stone against its natural inclinations or change its consistency. You could flatten or raise a mound, turn a section of stone wall into sand, carve an earthen stairway into a steep hillside, or open a new entrance to a cave complex. The shaped earth is still beholden to gravity, so this incantation could form a natural earthen bridge but could not allow a boulder to float in the air.

You can warp a quantity of soft earth that could fit into a 10 ft. cube, though the actual matter need not occupy such dimensions, or a quantity of a hard stone that could fit inside a 5 ft. cube. Each spark doubles the quantity of earth or stone affected.
